:= by
  haveI : Finite ↑(s ×ˢ ↑f) := Finite.Set.finite_prod s ↑f
  let f' : α → β := λ a, (f.choose a)
  let g : s ×ˢ ↑f → β := λ (a, b), b a
  have h : Set.InjOn g (s ×ˢ ↑f) :=
    ⟨λ ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ h₁ h₂, 
     by cases h₁; cases h₂; congr; exact Eq.symm (Set.mem_set_of_eq.1 h₁)⟩
  exact Finite.Set.finite_image2 g s ↑f
